Privacy

What we collect

When you contact us by WhatsApp, phone, fax or email, we receive the details you choose to send, such as your name, company, number and job details.

How we use it

We use these details only to reply to you, quote and carry out the job. We do not sell your details.

Button taps

This website counts taps on its WhatsApp, call, email and map buttons to see which buttons help visitors. It does not record your IP address or fingerprint your device.

Contact

To ask about or remove your details, email advance.movers@yahoo.com or call 07-236 9348.
